target_customer: Retail traders and later businesses hedging cultural and demand risk
problem: Cultural attention drives business results but cannot be traded or hedged directly.
business_model: Exchange with trading fees, planned as a regulated futures venue; trading is currently simulated money
product_category: Attention index exchange and derivatives marketplace

founders.name: Owen Botkin
founders.background_notes: Long/short equities at Balyasny per the YC page.

founders.name: Joseph Thomas
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at each employer per the YC page.

competitors.name: Polymarket with Kaito AI attention markets
competitors.what: Prediction markets resolving on social mindshare and sentiment scores
competitors.traction_then: Announced February 10, 2026, with dozens of markets planned for March and thousands by year end

competitors.name: Noise
competitors.what: Smaller prediction market with perpetual long and short mindshare contracts using Kaito data

technical_complexity.rationale: Building indices from search, social and streaming data is routine, but running a compliant exchange with clearing and matching is hard and needs CFTC approval.

defensibility.rationale: If a designated contract market license is granted it is a real barrier. Until then the product is a simulated money app that rivals can copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Polymarket moved into attention markets in 2026. No acquisition or copy of Forum found.

market_need_then: Prediction markets grew sharply in 2025 and 2026 (Kalshi volume over 17 billion dollars in 2025). Demand for tradable attention is unproven, and one third party review questioned the regulated claim before the CFTC filing.

branding.domain_note: Uses forum.market, not forum.com. Forum Markets Inc (Nasdaq FRMM) is an unrelated public company with a similar name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Finance and culture framing: we turn virality into tradable stocks, the attention market

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: the first exchange to trade on attention

brand_strength.rationale: Fitting word for a marketplace and a memorable tagline, but widely shared with other Forum companies and no brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Forum is a Winter 2026 company, active, whose exchange arm ForumEX is reported as a pending CFTC designated contract market applicant. No funding, exit or layoff reports were found. Prediction market momentum and Polymarket's own attention markets validate the idea but add a large competitor, and regulatory classification of attention derivatives is the main open risk.
notes: No funding found; other companies called Forum have 2023 and 2025 rounds that do not apply. The CFTC pending status comes from one outlet (DeFiRate) and was not cross-checked. The website forum.market fetch returned no usable content.
